data.name: Hanisha
data.long_meaning: Hanisha is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'hanishka' which means 'Goddess of prosperity and happiness'. In Hindu mythology, Hanisha is an aspect of the Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity. She is often depicted holding a lotus flower and a pot of gold coins, symbolizing abundance and material wealth.
